title: Today we're showing HoneyKeeper publicly for the first time.It's a cozy first-person life sim built around beekeeping — you inherit an apiary along with the debt attached to it, and work your way out one frame of honeycomb at a time.
author: No-Cow3446

comments.author: passyourownbutter
comments.body: Sweet! Do you also plant different types of flowers to produce different types of honey? Love this idea so far and looks great

replies.author: DullPossible415
replies.body: Yes, that’s something we want to add! Different types of honey are already partly implemented, but the flower-growing mechanic itself probably won’t be fully ready for the demo.

comments.author: BoltVnderhuge
comments.body: Very very nice! Will this teach me how to be an actual beekeeper?

replies.author: DullPossible415
replies.body: In a way, yes! We’re trying to make the beekeeping side as authentic as possible and capture the real spirit of it, while still keeping the game fun and accessible.

comments.author: SereneAlps3789
comments.body: Looks awesome!! Where’d you get the assets? Was that all ai generated too?

replies.author: DullPossible415
replies.body:
We’re using Synty assets, and we also have a 3D designer on the team.  
Btw, some of the icons for items are still a work in progress, so we’re using temporary AI-generated ones for now.

comments.author: barret232hxc
comments.body:
I actually wouldn't assume this game was made with ai if you hadn't told me. The quality looks very good and the art direction. Did you make the assets or have to highly edit them to make them look this cohesive and good quality?

where do we look for the game?

replies.author: DullPossible415
replies.body: We should have the Steam page up in the next few days, and the demo will be available there too.

replies.author: DullPossible415
replies.body:
Thanks! We use Synty assets as a base, but we also have a 3D designer on the team who creates and works on different models.

As for AI, it’s only being used for temporary item icons at the moment.

replies.author: barret232hxc
replies.body: i'm going to need to check out those assets b/c they look great. thanks for the info

comments.author: thecoffeejesus
comments.body: Upgrade it with Astra. Or did you already?

comments.body: I like the atmosphere of the game.
